token_pruning_64_tokens.description: Aggressive visual-token pruning claim. Paper reference values are from the LLaVA-1.5-7B 64-retained-token setting in Table 1; evidence/context component metrics are gym-only diagnostics with no paper reference values.

performance_retained.description: Headline retained-performance score combining query evidence and global-context preservation under the compressed-token budget.

evidence_retained.description: Mean query-evidence similarity retained by the compressed tokens; this catches methods that preserve global context while losing the local evidence needed for the answer.

context_retained.description: Mean global-context similarity retained by the compressed tokens; this catches relevance-only shortcuts that keep salient evidence but drop low-saliency contextual information.

mean_token_count.description: Mean number of retained visual tokens, used as a machine-independent compression-cost constraint.

retained_fraction.description: Fraction of the original visual tokens retained, penalizing methods that improve retention by relaxing the compression budget.

sample_count.description: Number of evaluated samples; included for auditability and not used for ranking.
